A limited-services '''spaceport''' served the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Galtea/Legends|Galtea]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. A [[Farm/Legends|farmers]] market and [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] bazaar were located close by.
